# FlavorAI

> AI-powered recipe discovery and generation. Create personalized recipes based on your ingredients, dietary needs, and preferences.

FlavorAI helps home cooks discover, save, and generate recipes using AI. Multilingual UI with 14 languages including RTL support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse featured AI-generated recipes and search the catalog.
- [Generate Recipe](/generate): Create a custom recipe from ingredients and preferences.
- [Recipes](/recipes): Browse all available recipes.
- [Categories](/categories): Explore recipes by cuisine and category.
- [Search](/search): Search recipes by name or ingredients.
- [Favorites](/favorites): Saved recipes for signed-in users.
- [Resources](/resources): Cooking tips, kitchen tools, pantry essentials, and conversion guides.
- [About](/about): Mission and technology behind FlavorAI.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the team.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth): Account access for saving recipes.
- [Profile](/profile): User account settings.
